summary: Added and executed focused non-GPU backend tests for new custody-delivery and callable-skill query flows using signed SYNTHETIC fixtures; then ran full backend regression excluding the 2 GPU connection suites.

minor.issue: Code-review risk: query status path returns prior view without explicit provisioning digest freshness check in the status route path (not reproduced as failing in this run).

All positive custody/skill proofs in this run are SYNTHETIC signed fixtures, not live source retrieval or live workload evidence.

success_rate.backend: 100% pass for new suites (18/18). Full non-GPU regression: 585 tests, 0 failed, 0 errors, 17 skipped.
success_rate.frontend: Not re-tested in this iteration (request scope backend-focused; UI previously smoke-verified).
